remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. Dated 1928 on basis of Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

credit_line: Gift of the Girard Foundation Collection
description: A delicate sketch of two heart-shaped, flowerlike forms rendered in blue, with one bloom on top of the other. The lower flower is drawn in detail, while gestural outlines form the other blossom.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
title: Untitled (Bleeding Heart)
